summary: Phase 11 — Conversion KPI + date range filter + editable low-stock threshold. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases passed (analytics/stats new fields, custom/invalid/swapped date ranges, auth guard, conversion math, store-config low_stock_threshold + restock_safety_days CRUD + sibling preservation + zero-edge case + insights reflecting threshold). Frontend: dashboard StockThresholdEditor + traffic page date range filter + chart all rendered with all expected data-testids and triggered correct backend calls. ONE FRONTEND BUG FOUND: 'Konversi Rentang' KPI card renders 'NaN' instead of the conversion percentage because StatCard.formatNum coerces the string value '14.29%' via Number() which yields NaN.

minor.issue: When low_stock_threshold is set to 0, server falls back to default 10 because of `cfg.get('low_stock_threshold') or 10` (0 is falsy). Probably intended behaviour for the 'disable low-stock alerts' case, but mark this — frontend allows 1-9999, so user cannot set 0 from UI anyway. If the design intent is to ALLOW 0 = disable alerts, change to `cfg.get('low_stock_threshold') if cfg.get('low_stock_threshold') is not None else 10`.

ui_bugs.issue: Card shows 'NaN' instead of the conversion percentage. Root cause: StatCard renders `value` through formatNum = (n) => Number(n || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID'). The Konversi card passes value=`${stats.conversion_rate}%` (e.g. '14.29%'), but Number('14.29%') === NaN, so .toLocaleString() returns 'NaN'. Suggested fix: either (a) pass the raw number and let StatCard add '%' for percentage cards via an optional `suffix` prop, or (b) special-case StatCard to detect a string value and render as-is without formatNum, or (c) format the number outside StatCard and pass pre-formatted string while bypassing formatNum.

(Optional) Decide whether low_stock_threshold=0 should disable alerts or fall back to 10 — currently falls back. Frontend already enforces min=1 so this is only theoretical.

rca_of_the_issue: Bug: 'Konversi Rentang' KPI shows 'NaN'. Reproduction: Login at /#/seller (PIN=ciltarasa) → sidebar-tab-traffic → 'Konversi Rentang' card on top row. Root cause: AdminPages.js line 524 passes `value={`${stats.conversion_rate}%`}` (a string like '14.29%') into StatCard; StatCard formats it via formatNum (line 374) which does `Number(n || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID')`. `Number('14.29%')` evaluates to NaN, then NaN.toLocaleString returns 'NaN'. Mitigation options: (1) make StatCard skip formatNum for string values: `{typeof value === 'string' ? value : formatNum(value)}`; (2) pass numeric value and accept a `suffix` prop in StatCard.
